test_fillna: test the fillna method on an Index or Series object with a fill value
test_fillna_null: test the fillna method replaces null values (np.nan or None) with a specified fill value
test_fillna_multiindex: test that fillna raises NotImplementedError when called on a MultiIndex object
test_fillna_tuple_object_index: test fillna with a tuple fill value on an Index containing None and tuple elements
test_fillna_shallow_copy: test that fillna returns a shallow copy of the original Index or Series object
